items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I knew Johnny, but I never knew Leonard.

ctx.x: Well, you know, you never mentioned, don't know who I never mentioned, a fellow by the name of Bosdorfer. He was very young. Leonard? Leonard Bosdorfer.
I knew Johnny, but I never knew Leonard.

Oh, Leonard. Leonard played. Oh, he died very young. Oh, I doubt whether he was in his twenties when he died. Well, that was before my time. He played by air too. And he was a very good piano player too. Leonard Bosdorfer, yeah. Yeah, I liked Leonard in those days. He was a wonderful fellow, but he died very, very young. Guy McCormick died. He was only 37 years old. When he died, he died of a heart attack. And my other father, Fuzzy Wuzzy Twins, he died rather young too. Now, Eddie?
